description: The one shape every 4xx and 5xx response takes. The message is always the catalogue's fixed text for the code; it is never built from an exception, and it never carries a value the caller sent.
title: PGx API error envelope (WP-16)

ACTIVE_RELEASE_UNAVAILABLE.message: No governed active release is available.

ARTIFACT_INCONSISTENT.message: Two governed artifacts disagree, so no answer was produced.

ASSESSMENT_INPUT_INVALID.message: The assessment input could not be read as a canonical input.

ASSESSMENT_NOT_FOUND.message: No stored assessment carries that identifier.

CANDIDATE_RUNTIME_NOT_CONFIGURED.message: This deployment runs the candidate track but no candidate release or candidate assessment service is composed.

CATALOGUE_UNAVAILABLE.message: No governed catalogue is available for the active release.

CLAIM_BOUNDARY_NOT_APPROVED.message: The claim boundary has not been approved, so no assessment may be executed. This is a governance gate, not a problem with the request.

CONCURRENT_STATE_CHANGE.message: Stored state moved while this request was being served.

CURSOR_RELEASE_MISMATCH.message: The supplied cursor was created for a different release.

EVIDENCE_BUILD_UNAVAILABLE.message: No sealed evidence build is available.

EVIDENCE_NOT_FOUND.message: No evidence record carries that identifier in the pinned build.

EXPERT_REVIEW_ALREADY_COMPLETED.message: This review is complete and immutable.

EXPERT_REVIEW_AUDIT_FAILED.message: The audit event could not be appended, so the governed action was rolled back.

EXPERT_REVIEW_CASE_MANIFEST_MISMATCH.message: The case manifest hash no longer matches the pinned one.

EXPERT_REVIEW_EXPECTATION_ALREADY_LOCKED.message: An expected response is already recorded; it cannot be replaced, only corrected by appending.

EXPERT_REVIEW_EXPECTATION_REQUIRED.message: The expected response must be recorded before anything is revealed.

EXPERT_REVIEW_FORGED_FIELD.message: The request supplied a field the server owns.

EXPERT_REVIEW_INVALIDATED.message: This review was invalidated and cannot be continued.

EXPERT_REVIEW_INVALID_TRANSITION.message: The requested move is not permitted from the current state.

EXPERT_REVIEW_NOT_ASSIGNED.message: No active assignment. Returned identically whether the case is unknown, is not an expert-holdout case, or belongs to another reviewer.

EXPERT_REVIEW_NOT_AVAILABLE.message: The expert review service, its store or its dependencies are unavailable.

EXPERT_REVIEW_PERMIT_INVALID.message: No assignment-scoped permit authorises this payload read.

EXPERT_REVIEW_PROTOCOL_MISMATCH.message: The protocol hash no longer matches the pinned one.

EXPERT_REVIEW_PROTOCOL_NOT_APPROVED.message: The blind review protocol has not been approved by named human and scientific reviewers.

EXPERT_REVIEW_RELEASE_MISMATCH.message: The pinned release no longer matches the one this review began under.

EXPERT_REVIEW_RESULT_ALREADY_REVEALED.message: The result was revealed once; a second reveal cannot recalculate it.

EXPERT_REVIEW_REVEAL_REQUIRED.message: The system result must be revealed before a decision is recorded.

EXPERT_REVIEW_ROLE_REQUIRED.message: Only the exact EXPERT_REVIEWER role may act in the blind review protocol.

FORBIDDEN_ROLE.message: The authenticated principal does not hold the required role.

INPUT_KIND_NOT_PERMITTED.message: The supplied input kind is not permitted for this product phase.

INTERNAL_ERROR.message: The request could not be completed.

MODE_NOT_PERMITTED.message: The requested operation mode is not enabled for this product phase.

PERSISTENCE_REFUSED.message: The calculated assessment could not be stored, so nothing was stored.

PROHIBITED_INPUT_FIELD.message: The request carries a field this product does not accept.

RELEASE_NOT_ACTIVE.message: The requested release is not the active release.

REQUEST_CONTRACT_VIOLATION.message: The request is valid JSON but does not satisfy the governed input contract.

REQUEST_ID_INVALID.message: The supplied request identifier is not a canonical UUID.

REQUEST_MALFORMED.message: The request body could not be read as JSON.

REQUEST_TOO_LARGE.message: The request body exceeds the accepted size.

RUNTIME_TRACK_MISMATCH.message: The capability requested belongs to the release track this deployment does not serve. Candidate and governed releases carry different authorities and no request crosses between them.

SERVICE_NOT_READY.message: A required component is not ready to serve this endpoint.

STORED_RESULT_INCONSISTENT.message: A stored result did not verify against its recorded hashes and was not returned.

UNAUTHENTICATED.message: This endpoint requires an authenticated principal.

UNSUPPORTED_PHENOTYPE.message: The phenotype value is not supported by the active release.
